title: ID0378060-DC/Si-D/SE [MP / P9 170001021] DC2 Outlet not ready - HPC charging cable cooling error
description:
Reported behavior/issue:  Keeting these error on the charger.
DC2 Outlet not ready - HPC charging cable cooling error
PLC-Error-Flag DC2_CoolingUnit_EP1_Fan/Pump
Root cause: All evidence points to CAN communication problem
Solution: Check the line of the CAN communication

additional_info.subject: ID0378060-DC/Si-D/SE [MP / P9 170001021] DC2 Outlet not ready - HPC charging cable cooling error CRM:00315001729
additional_info.body:
Hello ﻿Magnus,﻿
Thank you for reaching out to eMobility Support. My name is
Francisco
, and I will be assisting you with your following query today:
Product
: Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset
:
MP / P9 170001021
ChargerID/Serial No.
:
003HJH
Problem Description
:
PLC-Error-Flag 'DC2_CoolingUnit_EP1_Fan/Pump' changed to true - (BUS: 0 GSH: 1 GSS: 0 SDC: 0 SLK: 0 ErrorCode: 3)
Troubleshooting
:
From the Error Codes, it seems like the CAN communication between EcoG and the Outlet's Microcontroller was lost. And after a possible reboot, it came back again.
As you can see here below, these are the codes that are in "0" as the logs show. All of them are related to the CAN.
Afterwards, I used the AWS to confirm that there were multiple errors in the same timestamp, leading me to believe that there is no faulty component.
To understand what went wrong we need to check this line, from the XD101, the orange and white cable both should have 60Ohm until the KF11.
There are only 3 possibilities to what the problem might be:
Microcontroller CAN communication line was stopped/lost (HW/FW error)
XD12 loose wiring (very unlikely)
KF11 CAN communication error, possibly translating the information.
What is your opinion? From my perspective, we can test this when the error is online but you need to request to the customer to leave the charger in error.
For future reference, your ticket number is
0378060
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Francisco de Matos Joaquim

additional_info.subject: ID0378060-DC/Si-D/SE [MP / P9 170001021] DC2 Outlet not ready - HPC charging cable cooling error CRM:00315001729
additional_info.body:
Hi Magnus,
Thanks for the feedback.
My suggestion would be to check if the wires are properly inserted in the terminals and also if the connector XD12 is not loose.
Since the error was only once, I cannot say to replace it.
What do you want to do next? Should I send this ticket to RC-SE and you perform this troubleshooting or should I close the ticket and if the error reoccurs in the future we will then move to site?
Thank you!
Best regards,
Francisco
